scope.description: Installed Zed 10x external-agent and remote-execution journeys across Mac-local and Mac-to-Intrepid projects, including private environment delivery for every SSH-launched consumer
excluded: Provider account repair beyond ordinary route readiness
Implementing secure environment transport for Windows SSH, WSL, or Docker in this POSIX SSH correction

stack.archetype: native desktop application with a remote Linux server and external process integrations
stack.framework: GPUI desktop application with protobuf remote transport, SSH subprocesses, PTYs, ACP, MCP, and DAP

requirements.text: Every supported installed-product surface exposes the host-valid external-agent inventory after cold open and reconnect.
A selected agent launches on the project execution host and reads exact project bytes through an ACP tool call.
Caller-supplied remote environment values never appear in local executable paths, process arguments, command debug output, or logs.
Remote terminals, tasks, shell commands, ACP, context servers, and stdio/TCP debug adapters retain their resolved directory, configured, and task-specific environment semantics.
A private environment frame is completely consumed before the first application stdin or protocol byte, without echoing through a PTY.
Missing capability, malformed or incomplete frame, oversize input, timeout, replacement, or unsupported backend fails closed without command-line fallback.
Completion, cancellation, and timeout leave no owned SSH, bootstrap, terminal, agent, context-server, or debug-adapter process residue.

The normal user entry point resolves to the canonical installed app, whose matching remote server advertises both secure environment capabilities and launches from its home-anchored location after changing to the project directory.

knownDefects.evidence: Initial inventory could arrive before the client handler and was not replayed.
The original route canary did not cross the installed Zed client/server seam.
A live restored remote terminal exposed resolved project environment values in the local SSH process argv.
The prior release plan covered ACP but omitted sibling terminal, task, shell, MCP, and DAP consumers and cited a nonexistent repository ADR path.
A normal Zed 10x restart reopened a stale same-identifier source bundle even though the canonical installed app contained the remote bootstrap correction.
